title: stats carries daily, by_model, by_profile, totals, cache
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert {'daily','by_model','by_profile','totals','cache'} <= set(d)"

title: totals has cost, requests, tokens
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); t=d['totals']; assert {'cost','requests','tokens','prompt_tokens','completion_tokens'} <= set(t); assert t['requests']>0"

title: by_model cost sums to the total cost
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=sum(v['cost'] for v in d['by_model'].values()); assert abs(s-d['totals']['cost'])<0.02, (s, d['totals']['cost'])"

title: by_profile cost sums to the total cost
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=sum(v['cost'] for v in d['by_profile'].values()); assert abs(s-d['totals']['cost'])<0.02, (s, d['totals']['cost'])"

title: by_model requests sum to the total requests
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=sum(v['requests'] for v in d['by_model'].values()); assert s==d['totals']['requests'], (s, d['totals']['requests'])"

title: daily has a cost per day, no gaps in the window
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); days=d['daily']; assert len(days)>=1; assert all('date' in x and 'cost' in x for x in days); ds=[x['date'] for x in days]; assert ds==sorted(ds), 'daily not chronological'"

title: cache reports hits, misses and savings consistently
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); c=d['cache']; assert {'hit_tokens','miss_tokens','savings'} <= set(c); assert c['hit_tokens']>=0 and c['miss_tokens']>=0; assert c['savings']>=0"

title: /api/usage/totals agrees with stats.totals
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats' > /tmp/us1.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/totals' > /tmp/us2.json; python3 -c "import json; s=json.load(open('/tmp/us1.json'))['totals']; t=json.load(open('/tmp/us2.json')); assert s['requests']==t['requests'], (s['requests'],t['requests']); assert abs(s['cost']-t['cost'])<0.01"

title: a provider filter narrows without changing shape
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/stats?provider=deepseek' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d['totals']['requests']>=0; assert {'daily','by_model','by_profile','totals'} <= set(d)"

title: profile-series has one value per day, per profile
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/usage/profile-series' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); n=d['days']; assert len(d['dates'])==n, (len(d['dates']), n); bad=[(p, len(v.get('cost') or [])) for p,v in d['profiles'].items() if len(v.get('cost') or [])!=n]; assert not bad, bad"

title: daily-costs returns a non-empty series
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/daily-costs' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(d['daily_costs'])>0"

title: the usage page renders its tables
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/usage' | python3 -c "import sys,re; h=sys.stdin.read(); assert 'Usage' in h; assert len(re.findall(r'<caption', h))>=1, 'no captions'"

title: routing status reports policy, rules and decisions
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert isinstance(d['enabled'],bool); assert isinstance(d['policy'],str) and d['policy']; assert isinstance(d['rules'],list); assert isinstance(d['recent_decisions'],list)"

title: routing status covers every configured profile
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/profiles' > /tmp/pf.json; python3 -c "import json; r=set(json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['per_profile']); p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/pf.json'))['profiles']); assert not (p-r), sorted(p-r)"

title: every routed provider is a configured provider
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers' > /tmp/pv.json; python3 -c "import json; r=set(json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['providers']); p=set(json.load(open('/tmp/pv.json'))['providers']); assert not (r-p), sorted(r-p)"

title: recent decisions also appear in the decision log
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/routing/status' > /tmp/rt.json; curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/work/provider-decisions?per=50' > /tmp/dl.json; python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('/tmp/rt.json'))['recent_decisions']; l=json.load(open('/tmp/dl.json'))['rows']; assert len(r)>0 and len(l)>0; assert {x.get('provider') for x in r} <= {x.get('provider') for x in l}"

title: provider health summary counts match its own provider list
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/health' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); s=d['summary']; n=len(d['providers']); assert s['total']==n, (s['total'], n); assert s['healthy']+s['degraded']+s['dead']==n, s"

title: failover rows carry from/to/provider
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/failovers' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); rows=d['failovers']; assert isinstance(rows,list); assert all(isinstance(x,dict) and x for x in rows[:5])"

title: provider presets are non-empty and shaped
cmd: curl -s '{{BASE}}/api/providers/presets' | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); pr=d['presets']; assert isinstance(pr,dict) and pr, 'no presets'; assert all(isinstance(v,dict) for v in pr.values())"
